health
健康
How do you make time for your health during a demanding week?
I protect a short lunch break for my health. Eating away from my desk also gives me a needed pause.
再忙，我也會為了健康留下一點午休時間。離開書桌吃飯，也能讓自己喘口氣。
exercise
運動
What kind of exercise could fit naturally into your day?
Walking to a nearby shop is exercise I can fit into my day. I enjoy having a destination rather than counting every step.
走路去附近商店，是能融入生活的運動。有個目的地，比一直算步數更適合我。
sleep
睡眠
What would you change if late-night messages kept interrupting your sleep?
I would silence nonessential messages to protect my sleep. I would tell friends that I might reply the next morning.
我會關掉不重要的訊息提示，保護睡眠。也先告訴朋友，我可能隔天早上才回。
rest
休息
How do you recognize when you need rest instead of another cup of coffee?
When I keep rereading the same line, I need rest. A short pause is more useful than forcing myself to continue badly.
同一行字反覆看還是看不進去，就該休息。停一下，比勉強做卻一直出錯有用。
energy
體力
Which activities use up the most energy for you?
Basketball practice after school uses the most energy for me. Afterwards, I need a snack and a short rest before I can start my homework.
放學後的籃球練習最耗體力。練完之後，我得先吃點東西、休息一下，才有辦法寫功課。
stress
壓力
What helps you talk about stress without feeling that you are complaining?
I describe the source of my stress and what help I need. A specific request makes the conversation easier to act on.
我會說明壓力來自哪裡，也講清楚需要什麼協助。有具體請求，對方比較知道怎麼幫忙。
tired
累
What would you say if friends invited you out when you felt tired?
I would say I was tired and suggest another day. I would rather meet when I could genuinely enjoy their company.
我會坦白說自己累了，再約別天。精神好一點見面，才更能享受相處的時間。
habit
習慣
Which small habit would you like to change, and what could replace it?
I want to change the habit of checking my phone during meals. I could leave it in another room while eating.
我想改掉吃飯看手機的習慣。吃飯時把手機留在別的房間，應該比較做得到。
routine
作息
What part of your routine helps you switch off after a busy day?
A short walk after dinner is part of my evening routine. It helps me clear my head before I start my homework.
晚餐後散個步是我作息的一部分。走一走能讓腦袋放空，再開始寫功課。
diet
飲食
How would you adjust your diet when eating away from home every day?
I would look for more variety in my diet. Choosing different vegetables across the week would be a manageable starting point.
我會讓飲食多一點變化。先從一週輪流吃不同蔬菜開始，比較容易做到。
doctor
醫生
What would you prepare before discussing a concern with a doctor?
I would write down my symptoms and questions for the doctor. That would help me remember important details during the appointment.
看醫生前，我會寫下症狀和想問的問題。就診時，才不容易漏掉重要細節。
appointment
預約
You can no longer attend a medical appointment. What would you do?
I would call to change the appointment as early as possible. Someone else might be able to use the time I no longer need.
我會盡早打電話更改預約。空出來的時段，也許能讓有需要的人使用。
symptom
症狀
How would you describe a symptom clearly during a consultation?
I would describe when the symptom started and how it affects my day. I would avoid guessing a diagnosis before discussing it.
我會說明症狀何時開始，以及怎麼影響日常生活。先把狀況講清楚，不急著自己下診斷。
medicine
藥
What would you do if you did not understand the instructions for a medicine?
I would ask a pharmacist to explain the medicine instructions. I would not guess about an unclear dose or change it myself.
藥的說明看不懂，我會請藥師解釋。不猜測模糊的劑量，也不自行更改。
recover
恢復
How could you support a friend who needs time to recover from an illness?
I would ask what would help them recover comfortably. Bringing groceries might be more useful than expecting them to entertain visitors.
我會問怎樣能讓他安心恢復。幫忙買生活用品，可能比去探訪、讓他忙著招待更實用。
injury
受傷
How would you include a friend whose injury prevents them from joining a hike?
I would suggest a different outing while the injury heals. Spending time together matters more than keeping the original plan.
朋友受傷需要休養，我會提議換個活動。能一起相處，比照原計畫健行更重要。
pain
疼痛
If you hurt your ankle, how would you describe the pain to your coach or parents?
I would explain where the pain is and when it gets worse. For example, I would say it hurts most when I walk down the stairs.
我會說明哪裡痛，還有什麼時候疼痛會變嚴重。例如，下樓梯的時候最痛。
prevent
避免
What could prevent you from staying up too late on school nights?
Setting a bedtime alarm could prevent me from staying up too late. I could also charge my phone outside my bedroom.
設一個睡覺時間的鬧鐘，可以避免我熬夜太晚。我也可以把手機放在房間外面充電。
mental
心理
How would you respond to someone who feels uncomfortable discussing mental health?
I would not pressure them to discuss their mental health. I would offer to listen whenever they felt ready.
對方不想談心理健康，我不會勉強。只會告訴他，準備好時我願意聽。
physical
身體
How can you tell the difference between wanting a challenge and ignoring physical limits?
I notice whether physical tiredness is affecting my balance or concentration. I can choose a smaller challenge instead of pushing through everything.
我會留意身體疲勞是否影響平衡或專注。挑戰可以調整，不必每次都硬撐到底。
breath
呼吸
What would you do before giving a speech if you felt rushed?
I would pause and take a slow breath before starting. Looking at my first sentence would help me settle into the speech.
開始講話前，我會停一下，慢慢呼吸。再看看第一句，讓自己慢慢進入狀況。
relax
放鬆
What helps you relax without looking at another screen?
I relax by watering my plants and listening to music. Neither activity asks me to keep responding to new information.
我會澆花、聽音樂來放鬆。這兩件事都不用一直對新的資訊做反應。
regular
固定
How would you fit regular breaks into a long evening of homework?
I would take regular breaks after finishing each subject. Stopping at a natural point would make the breaks easier to keep short.
我會每寫完一科就固定休息一下。在告一段落時停下來，休息比較不會拖太久。
moderate
適度
If you had not exercised for months, what moderate activity would you start with?
I would choose a moderate walk at a comfortable pace. The first outing should feel manageable rather than like a test.
久沒活動後，我會先選步調舒服的適度散步。第一次出門，不必變成對自己的考驗。
